newsitem.title: UK: Dollar wobbles on Tietmeyer, steadies on EMU fears.
newsitem.headline: Dollar wobbles on Tietmeyer, steadies on EMU fears.

text.p: An upwardly-mobile dollar wobbled around European midsession after Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer called for a strong mark, but remained supported by nagging fears of a broad, weak European single currency.

The dollar had hit four-week highs in early trade as the German government retreated from controversial plans to revalue assets to help make the grade for EMU. It stalled ahead of Tietmeyer's comment, which sent it dipping beneath 1.73 marks.
A Bonn/Bundesbank compromise that funds from the asset revaluation would be transferred only in 1998 was seen increasing chances that a broad group of countries would launch EMU.
